messages:
Maya (seceng): Heads up 1  planning a coordinated base-image rebase next Wednesday to land CVE fixes for glibc and the telemetry forwarder. Need to lock down RBAC and KMS posture first. Who's available for a quick run-through? :calendar:

Liam (eng-infra): +1. We should avoid granting 'secrets: get' to the forwarder if possible. Proposal: forwarder authenticates via workload identity to a signer service that exposes a Sign RPC. No key material inside the pod.

Ravi (runtime): Agreed. For the runtime we can add a sidecar injector patch that mounts the signer-agent as an init container for handshake + mTLS. That keeps forwarder ephemeral and patchable. Ops likes sidecar for fast CVE rollouts.

Maya (seceng): For Private deployments customers wanted attestation coverage at the base-image level. How do we reconcile attestation + sidecar patching?

Liam (eng-infra): Two options: 1) attest the base image and separately attest the sidecar image and require both attestations before admission, or 2) vendor-provide the sidecar as part of the rebase and pin it for the release window. I prefer #1. Simpler for customers that want quick patches.

Sam (oncall): From SRE POV: add detection for anomalous signing frequency and failed-sign attempts. Example alerts: >200 sign ops/min for a single SA, >5 consecutive sign failures from same pod -> page. Also emit signer-agent health metrics to monitoring.

Maya (seceng): Good. Also we need a preflight checklist in the rebase playbook to fail fast if the signer-agent is missing or misconfigured. Can we codify that?

Ravi (runtime): I'll add a preflight job that validates: 1) signer-agent deployment exists and is Ready, 2) sidecar image digest matches attestation registry, 3) token exchange test succeeds. Sample kubectl for token test:

```bash
# short-lived token test
kubectl create token telemetry-sa --duration=2m --namespace=platform | xargs -I{} curl -s -X POST https://signer.example.internal/v1/sign -H "Authorization: Bearer {}" -d '{"payload":"hello"}'
```

Liam (eng-infra): We're adding a minimal RBAC RoleBound to allow the forwarder to request a TokenRequest. Example Role: 

```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: token-requester
rules:
- apiGroups: ["authentication.k8s.io"]
  resources: ["tokenreviews", "serviceaccounts/token"]
  verbs: ["create"]
```

Liam (eng-infra): That prevents storing long-lived secrets in pods. TokenRequest -> mapped IAM role -> KMS Sign.

Maya (seceng): CVE triage note: we discovered a medium vuln in the forwarder that allows log header poisoning in rare cases. We're planning a patch in the forwarder image. We should block any rebase that doesn't include the patched forwarder.

Sam (oncall): Ops request: schedule the canary before the KMS rotation window. kms-operator-bot shows rotation on 2024-11-07T03:00:00Z in staging. Let's avoid canaries inside that window.

kms-operator-bot: Notice: KMS rotation scheduled 2024-11-07T03:00:00Z. Staging signer keys will rotate; expect transient Sign RPC 5xx during rotation.

Maya (seceng): Thanks bot. Action items from this thread: 1) Liam to publish SA->IAM mapping + sample IAM policy for kms:Sign; 2) Ravi to push patched forwarder image + attestation and add preflight job to rebase playbook; 3) Sam to add alert rules for sign-rate and sign-failure; 4) eng-security (me) to own the hold-gates for the rebase (block if attestation missing or forwarder not patched).

Ravi (runtime): I'll drop the canary manifest and image:sha in this thread by EOD. Also adding a tmpfs encrypted buffer fallback when KMS is unreachable (wrap local key with KMS).

Liam (eng-infra): I'll write the preflight script snippet and add an IAM example to infra docs. Example IAM JSON (GCP style) for AsymmetricSign role: 

```json
{
  "bindings": [
    { "role": "roles/cloudkms.signer", "members": ["serviceAccount:project-sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"] }
  ]
}
```

Maya (seceng): Great. If folks can post PR links for docs + manifests by EOD tomorrow I'll stitch them into the rebase playbook. If we spot any regression during canary, we abort and roll back images. :triangular_flag_on_post:

Sam (oncall): I'll add the pager rules and run a short drill to validate runbook steps after canary completes.

Maya (seceng): Thanks everyone. Looping in product support after we lock dates. Ping me if blockers pop up. :lock:
